subject: Matemática
description_pt: Escolher e construir o gráfico mais adequado (colunas, setores, linhas), com ou sem uso de planilhas eletrônicas, para apresentar um determinado conjunto de dados, destacando aspectos como as medidas de tendência central.

components.description_pt: Identificar o tipo de gráfico mais apropriado para representar um conjunto de dados
components.description_en: Identify the most appropriate graph type to display a given data set
components.cc_component_description: Identify which mathematical tool is most appropriate for a given problem or task

components.description_pt: Construir gráficos de barras, pizza ou linhas para representar dados com ou sem software
components.description_en: Construct bar, pie, or line charts to represent a data set with or without spreadsheet software
components.cc_component_description: Use a scaled bar graph to represent a data set with several categories

components.description_pt: Destacar medidas de tendência central em uma representação gráfica selecionada
components.description_en: Highlight measures of central tendency within a selected graph representation
components.cc_component_description: Summarize numerical data sets in relation to their context by calculating quantitative measures of center (median and/or mean)

components.description_pt: Justificar a escolha de um tipo específico de gráfico baseado na natureza dos dados
components.description_en: Justify the choice of a specific graph type based on the nature of the data
components.cc_component_description: Justify the choice of a specific mathematical tool based on the demands of a problem

cc_matches.description: *Summarize numerical data sets in relation to their context, such as by* giving quantitative measures of center (median and/or mean) and variability (interquartile range and/or mean absolute deviation), as well as describing any overall pattern and any striking deviations from the overall pattern with reference to the context in which the data were gathered.

Draw a scaled picture graph and a scaled bar graph to represent a data set with several categories. Solve one- and two-step "how many more" and "how many less" problems using information presented in scaled bar graphs. *For example, draw a bar graph in which each square in the bar graph might represent 5 pets.*
